label: Alexa Download Status
info:
Answers "is the movie downloading?" for an Alexa Routine.

Flow: HTTP request -> validate language -> exec server_brain.py -> speak.

Setup:
1. Bind-mount voice/server_brain.py to /data/server_brain.py
2. Run bootstrap_telethon.sh once (installs telethon in the container)
3. Test: curl 'http://localhost:1880/download-status?lang=hinglish'

To make an Echo actually SAY the result, import
flows/alexa-tts-snippet.json as well -- it needs the
node-red-contrib-alexa-remote2 palette.

name: READ ME: endpoint is GET /download-status?lang=en|hi|hinglish
info:
The exec node runs in spawn mode, so no shell is involved and the
language argument cannot be used for command injection. The
validate-language function additionally whitelists the value.
